title: The Extra Plate
youtube_title: My grandma always set one extra plate. This year I forgot. #shorts #scarystories
caption: Grandma always set one extra plate at the holiday table. Nobody ever asked who it was for. Follow for a new scary story every day.
style: dark cinematic digital painting, eerie moonlight, deep shadows, muted palette, horror movie still

scenes.text: My grandmother always set one extra plate at the holiday table, and this year, for the first time, I forgot.
scenes.image_prompt: a long wooden dining table set for a holiday dinner, candles, one empty space at the end of the table with no plate, dim warm light, shadows

scenes.text: She passed away in the spring, so I hosted. Twelve chairs, twelve plates, the whole family home.
scenes.image_prompt: a cozy old farmhouse dining room at night, twelve chairs around a long table full of food, an old framed photograph on the wall, candlelight

scenes.text: Halfway through dinner, the candles dipped, and someone knocked three times on the front door.
scenes.image_prompt: candle flames bending sideways on a dinner table, smoke curling, a dark hallway leading to a front door in the background

scenes.text: Nobody was on the porch. Just cold air, and wet footprints walking past me into the house.
scenes.image_prompt: an open front door at night, an empty porch in moonlight, wet bare footprints on the wooden floor leading inside down the hallway

scenes.text: Back in the dining room, my uncle was staring at his plate. Someone had taken a bite from it.
scenes.image_prompt: close up of a dinner plate with food and one large bite missing, a fork lying untouched beside it, dim candlelight, dark background

scenes.text: Then my aunt's plate. Then my cousin's. One bite from every plate, while we all watched the door.
scenes.image_prompt: a row of dinner plates along a long table, each with a bite missing, family members seen only from behind in shadow, turned toward a doorway

scenes.text: That's when I remembered what Grandma told me as a kid. The extra plate isn't for guests. It's for whatever follows them home.
scenes.image_prompt: an old woman's wrinkled hands setting a single white plate on a dark table, soft moonlight through a window, nostalgic and eerie

scenes.text: So I set the plate, and the eating stopped. Then I counted the chairs. There were thirteen, and every single one was full.
scenes.image_prompt: a long dinner table viewed from the far end, thirteen chairs all occupied by dark silhouettes, one extra figure taller and thinner than the rest, candles, deep shadows
